symptom: An API-key or Sign-in MCP server on localhost passed the editor's connection check, but the chat gateway refused to reach it, so the chat had none of its tools.
rule: A personal gateway backend on this machine may use loopback HTTP exactly as its connection check does; organization backends never may. Drive the chat path with the URL the form check accepted. Principles 10 and 13.
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/agents/__tests__/mcp-registry.test.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/agents/gateway/__tests__/server.test.ts -t 'reach loopback|reaches a loopback backend'
